title: Super Supportive · Episode 1: Someone Who Answers
description: Two weeks after the disaster, young Alden receives a visitor. A small, unexpected conversation gives him something he has been missing: someone who takes his questions seriously.

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca
sources.note: Based on the user-supplied EPUB: chapter TWO: Mistakes through the scar exchange; brief memories from ONE: The Boy in the Bubble. Not an official translation. No permission or public-domain status inferred from web availability.

notice: A private Mandarin learning adaptation of Sleyca’s Super Supportive. Dialogue is simplified and brief choices rejoin the novel’s events. This opening takes place during Alden’s childhood and includes bereavement and recollections of injury.

两个星期了。我还在医院里，外面又在下雨。.pinyin: liǎng gè xīng qī le 。 wǒ hái zài yī yuàn lǐ ， wài miàn yòu zài xià yǔ 。
两个星期了。我还在医院里，外面又在下雨。.english: It has been two weeks. I am still in the hospital, and it is raining again outside.

Wummy就在我旁边。它是我的玩具，一直跟我在一起。.pinyin: Wummy jiù zài wǒ páng biān 。 tā shì wǒ de wán jù ， yì zhí gēn wǒ zài yì qǐ 。
Wummy就在我旁边。它是我的玩具，一直跟我在一起。.english: Wummy is right beside me. He is my stuffed toy, and he has stayed with me all along.

游戏机叫了一声。我马上把它关掉。我的耳朵里，也一直有这样的声音。.pinyin: yóu xì jī jiào le yì shēng 。 wǒ mǎ shàng bǎ tā guān diào 。 wǒ de ěr duo lǐ ， yě yì zhí yǒu zhè yàng de shēng yīn 。
游戏机叫了一声。我马上把它关掉。我的耳朵里，也一直有这样的声音。.english: The game console beeps. I turn it off immediately. There is a sound like that in my ears all the time, too.

那天晚上，我家出了事。我受伤了，爸爸妈妈再也没有回来。.pinyin: nà tiān wǎn shàng ， wǒ jiā chū le shì 。 wǒ shòu shāng le ， bà ba mā ma zài yě méi yǒu huí lái 。
那天晚上，我家出了事。我受伤了，爸爸妈妈再也没有回来。.english: Something terrible happened at home that night. I was injured, and Mom and Dad never came back.

interlinear.pinyin: zài yě méi yǒu huí lái 。

一位女英雄救了我。可是，谁来跟我说清楚，到底出了什么事？.pinyin: yí wèi nǚ yīng xióng jiù le wǒ 。 kě shì ， shuí lái gēn wǒ shuō qīng chǔ ， dào dǐ chū le shén me shì ？
一位女英雄救了我。可是，谁来跟我说清楚，到底出了什么事？.english: A woman superhero saved me. But who will explain what actually happened?

看看旁边的Wummy。.pinyin: kàn kàn páng biān de Wummy 。

外面一直在下雨。这里什么都不对，连安静的时候也不对。.pinyin: wài miàn yì zhí zài xià yǔ 。 zhè lǐ shén me dōu bú duì ， lián ān jìng de shí hòu yě bú duì 。
外面一直在下雨。这里什么都不对，连安静的时候也不对。.english: It keeps raining outside. Everything here feels wrong, even the quiet moments.

它还在这里。那天晚上，她连它也一起带走了。.pinyin: tā hái zài zhè lǐ 。 nà tiān wǎn shàng ， tā lián tā yě yì qǐ dài zǒu le 。
它还在这里。那天晚上，她连它也一起带走了。.english: He is still here. She took him along that night, too.

有人来看你。不过，你不想见她也没关系。.pinyin: yǒu rén lái kàn nǐ 。 bú guò ， nǐ bù xiǎng jiàn tā yě méi guān xì 。
有人来看你。不过，你不想见她也没关系。.english: Someone has come to visit you. But it is all right if you do not want to see her.

interlinear.gloss: if you do not want to see her

我一下子不动了。那天晚上的房间，又回到了我的眼前。.pinyin: wǒ yí xià zi bú dòng le 。 nà tiān wǎn shàng de fáng jiān ， yòu huí dào le wǒ de yǎn qián 。
我一下子不动了。那天晚上的房间，又回到了我的眼前。.english: I go still. The room from that night comes back before my eyes.

她把我放在一个银色的球里。我不疼了，却不能动，也不能说话。.pinyin: tā bǎ wǒ fàng zài yí gè yín sè de qiú lǐ 。 wǒ bù téng le ， què bù néng dòng ， yě bù néng shuō huà 。
她把我放在一个银色的球里。我不疼了，却不能动，也不能说话。.english: She put me inside a silver sphere. Nothing hurt anymore, but I could not move or speak.

interlinear.pinyin: yí gè yín sè de qiú lǐ 。

interlinear.gloss: I was no longer in pain,

她写给我看：你很安全。我们会带你去一个安全的地方。.pinyin: tā xiě gěi wǒ kàn ： nǐ hěn ān quán 。 wǒ men huì dài nǐ qù yí gè ān quán de dì fāng 。
她写给我看：你很安全。我们会带你去一个安全的地方。.english: She wrote for me to read: You are safe. We will take you somewhere safe.

interlinear.gloss: She wrote for me to read:

interlinear.pinyin: yí gè ān quán de dì fāng 。

我心里一直在问：爸爸妈妈呢？你也带走他们了吗？.pinyin: wǒ xīn lǐ yì zhí zài wèn ： bà ba mā ma ne ？ nǐ yě dài zǒu tā men le ma ？
我心里一直在问：爸爸妈妈呢？你也带走他们了吗？.english: In my mind, I kept asking: What about Mom and Dad? Did you take them with you, too?

interlinear.pinyin: dài zǒu tā men le ma ？

我可以请她回去。就算她是英雄，也不能想做什么就做什么。.pinyin: wǒ kě yǐ qǐng tā huí qù 。 jiù suàn tā shì yīng xióng ， yě bù néng xiǎng zuò shén me jiù zuò shén me 。
我可以请她回去。就算她是英雄，也不能想做什么就做什么。.english: I can ask her to leave. Even a hero cannot just do whatever she wants.

我想见她！她在哪里？.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng jiàn tā ！ tā zài nǎ lǐ ？
我想见她！她在哪里？.english: I want to see her! Where is she?

她在下面等。等一下，我去请她上来。.pinyin: tā zài xià miàn děng 。 děng yí xià ， wǒ qù qǐng tā shàng lái 。
她在下面等。等一下，我去请她上来。.english: She is waiting downstairs. Give me a moment; I will ask her to come up.

她知道那天晚上的事。也许，她会把事情说清楚。.pinyin: tā zhī dào nà tiān wǎn shàng de shì 。 yě xǔ ， tā huì bǎ shì qing shuō qīng chǔ 。
她知道那天晚上的事。也许，她会把事情说清楚。.english: She knows what happened that night. Maybe she will explain it clearly.

interlinear.pinyin: nà tiān wǎn shàng de shì 。
bǎ shì qing shuō qīng chǔ 。

门外，她也在等。她觉得自己早就应该来看这个孩子了。.english: Outside the room, she is waiting, too. She feels she should have visited this child much sooner.

interlinear.pinyin: zì jǐ zǎo jiù yīng gāi
lái kàn zhè ge hái zi le 。

她本来想先找到他的家人，问过以后再来。可是，他们一直找不到。.english: She originally wanted to find his family first and ask before visiting. But they still cannot find them.

interlinear.pinyin: tā men yì zhí zhǎo bú dào 。

现在，她得走进那个房间。她不知道该怎么面对他。.pinyin: xiàn zài ， tā děi zǒu jìn nà ge fáng jiān 。 tā bù zhī dào gāi zěn me miàn duì tā 。

我来看你。可以吗？.english: I came to see you. Is that okay?

我点点头。她这才走到床边，在椅子上坐下。.english: I nod. Only then does she come to the bedside and sit in the chair.

我还好。就是耳朵里一直有声音。他们还要看看我的肚子。.english: I am okay. There is just a noise in my ears all the time. They still need to check my stomach.

interlinear.pinyin: kàn kàn wǒ de dù zi 。

那块金属从窗户进来，让你受伤了。一定很疼。真的对不起。.english: That piece of metal came through the window and injured you. It must have hurt. I am really sorry.

我想知道那是什么。.english: I want to know what it was.
